rounds.name: Peloponnese Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Peloponnese peninsula in southern Greece is separated from the central mainland by the narrow Corinth Canal.

rounds.name: Yucatan Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Yucatan Peninsula separates the Gulf of Mexico from the Caribbean Sea and is composed predominantly of limestone.

rounds.name: Strait of Hormuz
rounds.fact: The Strait of Hormuz connects the Persian Gulf with the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea.

rounds.name: Mozambique Channel
rounds.fact: The Mozambique Channel is an arm of the Indian Ocean located between the island of Madagascar and southeast Africa.

rounds.name: Tasmania
rounds.fact: Tasmania is an island state of Australia separated from the mainland by the rough waters of Bass Strait.
